entries.title: 苔钟庭 · 旧钟下的微光
entries.prompt: Original instrumental dark-fairytale action-adventure game score. Beautiful memorable melody, expressive human-like instrumental phrasing, warm natural acoustic space, detailed bow and pluck articulations, clear musical development and transparent mix. All original composition. Strictly instrumental: no vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, narration or synthetic voices. No chiptune, beeps, EDM drops, trap beat, trailer braams, clipping or excessively compressed wall of sound. A quiet moss-covered subterranean courtyard with forgotten bronze bells, tender melancholy and curiosity, a small pilgrim discovering an ancient world. Around 72 BPM, D dorian, expressive solo cello and violin singing a lyrical original theme over delicate harp arpeggios, wooden flute answers, warm chamber strings, rare soft bronze bell notes. Open with an immediately recognisable intimate melody rather than a long drone introduction. Over two minutes develop an A-B-A-prime form: lyrical opening, a more mysterious intimate middle with harp and cello, then a restrained luminous return. Breathing room between phrases, gentle changes of harmony, very light or no percussion. A beautiful game exploration cue that stays interesting through repeated listening. End softly in a harmony compatible with the opening for later loop editing.

entries.title: 苔钟守母 · 铜钟与针锋
entries.prompt: Original instrumental dark-fairytale action-adventure game score. Beautiful memorable melody, expressive human-like instrumental phrasing, warm natural acoustic space, detailed bow and pluck articulations, clear musical development and transparent mix. All original composition. Strictly instrumental: no vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, narration or synthetic voices. No chiptune, beeps, EDM drops, trap beat, trailer braams, clipping or excessively compressed wall of sound. A nimble duel against the guardian of an ancient moss-covered bell court. Elegant urgent chamber-orchestral boss battle theme, memorable lyrical violin melody over articulated cello and viola ostinatos, crisp acoustic strings, occasional bassoon and restrained low horn, bronze bell accents and selective light orchestral percussion. D minor, lively 6/8, around 138 BPM. Short two-bar encounter gesture then immediately establish a strong original melodic hook; create exhilarating rhythmic conversation between melody and low strings. Across two minutes introduce a contrasting agile middle passage and a heightened final return with a clear counterline. Give the guardian an identity through thematic development, not loudness. Keep instrument attacks clean and leave spectral space for weapon and warning sound effects. Avoid constant percussion, generic epic trailer chords and indiscriminate fortissimo. A graceful, thrilling, playable battle loop with a controlled ending.
